## Purpose

Describe the educational, scientific, or engineering problem this change addresses.

## Claim boundary

- [ ] Executable behavior is linked to a test or artifact.
- [ ] Conceptual simulations are labelled as simulations.
- [ ] External/product claims cite a primary source and an `as of` date.
- [ ] Unknown or proprietary internals remain explicitly unknown.

## Verification

List exact commands, inputs, seeds, hashes, screenshots, and relevant accessibility checks.

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No secret, credential, personal data, model weight, generated database, or runtime log is included.
- [ ] New connector behavior is opt-in, scoped, schema-validated, and auditable.
- [ ] Safety-sensitive interpretability work does not distribute bypassed model weights.

## Documentation and licenses

- [ ] User-facing behavior and Persian/English terminology are documented.
- [ ] Code, data, model, font, and media licenses were checked separately.
